# Financial Integrity & Accounting Checklist: EP-CTA - Cuentas y Tarjetas

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of requirements governing financial integrity, ledger consistency, accounting invariants, and debt lifecycles across EP-CTA (HU-07 to HU-13).
**Created**: 2026-09-22
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## 1. Liquid Accounts & Opening Movements (HU-07)

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the indivisible creation of an account and its opening movement specified so that neither can exist without the other? [Completeness, Spec §RN-10, §RF-C01]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are the correction mechanics for opening balance amount and date explicitly defined as auditable adjustments rather than in-place mutations? [Clarity, Spec §RN-10, §HU-07.7]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the handling for opening currency correction unambiguously defined as archiving and recreating the account without currency conversion? [Clarity, Spec §RN-10, §HU-07.7]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are boundary rules explicitly defined for initial balance amounts, specifically allowing zero but rejecting negative values for liquid asset accounts? [Edge Case, Spec §RF-C01, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are the criteria distinguishing allowable physical deletion (no movements, no debt, no dependencies) from mandatory non-destructive archiving objectively verifiable? [Measurability, Spec §RN-CTA-02, §HU-07.5]
- [ ] CHK006 - Does the spec explicitly define whether an archived account continues contributing its historical balances to past periods and net worth calculations? [Consistency, Spec §RN-CTA-02, §HU-07.5]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the quota consumption model for the Free tier explicitly quantified for active accounts, archived accounts, and exempted instruments (cash and Cuenta Metas)? [Completeness, Spec §RN-CTA-03, §HU-07.1]

## 2. Card Registration & Debit Linking (HU-08)

- [ ] CHK008 - Does the spec explicitly state that registering a debit card creates zero independent balance and strictly mirrors the linked savings account? [Consistency, Spec §RF-C03, §RN-01]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the currency compatibility requirement between a debit card and its linked account unambiguously defined? [Clarity, Spec §RF-C03, §HU-08.1]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are the consequences of archiving a linked bank account on its attached debit card's operational status explicitly specified? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §HU-08.1]
- [ ] CHK011 - Does the spec define how the Free tier quota accounts for debit cards and their linked accounts (consuming two quotas despite sharing one asset balance)? [Clarity, Spec §RN-CTA-03, §HU-08.8]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are handling requirements defined for duplicate card registrations matching an existing card's issuer, network, and last four digits? [Edge Case, Spec §RF-C02, §HU-08.7]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are PAN and CVV rejection requirements specified across all input avenues, including free-text alias and issuer fields? [Coverage, Spec §RF-C05, §RN-02]

## 3. Credit Line, Debt & Utilization Metrics (HU-09 & HU-10)

- [ ] CHK014 - Is the mathematical separation of credit line and available credit from real cash and net worth stated as an absolute domain invariant? [Clarity, Spec §RN-01, §RF-C04]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are the mathematical formulas for credit used, available credit, and utilization percentage explicitly defined with clear floor/ceiling boundaries? [Clarity, Spec §RF-C04, §HU-09.2]
- [ ] CHK016 - Does the spec explicitly specify the system behavior and display state when a credit card's authorized limit is zero? [Edge Case, Spec §RF-C04, §HU-09.4]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are requirements defined for debt exceeding the credit limit, specifically that available credit remains zero and debt does not get truncated? [Edge Case, Spec §RF-C04, §HU-09.3]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is the calendar adjustment rule for cut-off and due dates on days 29–31 during short months specified without permanently mutating the user's preferred day? [Clarity, Spec §RF-C04, §HU-09.5]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are utilization threshold crossing (50%, 80%, 100%), multi-threshold leap, and individual re-arming requirements fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §RF-C07, §HU-10.1-HU-10.4]

## 4. Debt Amortization & Card Payments (HU-12)

- [ ] CHK020 - Does the spec explicitly require that credit card payments be modeled as internal amortizing transfers that produce zero operational expense or income? [Consistency, Spec §RN-06, §RF-C10]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is the symmetric reduction of source liquid funds and outstanding credit liability specified as an indivisible atomic operation? [Clarity, Spec §RN-06, §RF-C10, §HU-12.1]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are rejection requirements unambiguously specified when a proposed payment exceeds the current outstanding credit card debt? [Edge Case, Spec §RF-C10, §HU-12.3]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are eligible payment funding sources explicitly restricted to active savings and checking accounts, excluding cash and digital wallets? [Clarity, Spec §RF-C10, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for handling payment retry attempts to ensure idempotent ledger processing without duplicate balance reductions? [Coverage, Spec §RF-C10, §HU-12.5, §RT-02]

## 5. Credit Purchases & Installment Simulation (HU-13)

- [ ] CHK025 - Does the spec mandate that detected credit card purchases remain unconfirmed candidates with zero balance or expense effect until explicit user confirmation? [Clarity, Spec §RF-C11, §HU-13.1]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is it explicitly specified that confirmed credit purchases recognize the full principal as debt and operational expense on the purchase date regardless of installment plan length? [Consistency, Spec §RN-15, §RF-C11, §HU-13.2]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is the algorithm for distributing residual cents across installments specified to deterministically ensure the sum of installments equals the total financed amount? [Measurability, Spec §RN-15, §RF-C12, §HU-13.6]
- [ ] CHK028 - Does the spec explicitly prohibit recognizing simulated or projected interest as real debt or expense before confirmed posted charges occur? [Clarity, Spec §RN-15, §RF-C12, §HU-13.7]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are fallback requirements specified for installment simulations when neither a personal TEA nor a reference catalog rate is available? [Edge Case, Spec §RF-C12, §HU-13.5]

## 6. Interest Rate Catalog & Personal TEA (HU-11)

- [ ] CHK030 - Are mandatory disclaimer and verification date requirements specified for all reference catalog interest rates? [Clarity, Spec §RF-C08, §HU-11.1]
- [ ] CHK031 - Is the criterion or threshold for classifying a reference rate as outdated ("desactualizada") objectively defined? [Clarity, Spec §RF-C08, §HU-11.2]
- [ ] CHK032 - Does the spec state that modifying a personal TEA applies exclusively to future simulations and never alters confirmed historical transactions or schedules? [Consistency, Spec §RF-C09, §HU-11.3]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are acceptable value ranges and numeric format validation rules explicitly defined for personal TEA inputs? [Clarity, Spec §RF-C09, §HU-11.4]

## 7. Cross-Cutting Accounting Invariants & Data Integrity

- [ ] CHK034 - Are authoritative monetary amounts required to use integer minor units and avoid floating-point calculations across all financial operations? [Clarity, Spec §RT-05, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are multi-user data isolation requirements specified to ensure that aggregate calculations and balance lookups never leak or mix across user boundaries? [Coverage, Spec §RT-04, §RN-CTA-04]
- [ ] CHK036 - Does the spec specify that financial state changes must be persisted atomically to local storage before reporting operation success? [Completeness, Spec §RT-01, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK037 - Are conflict resolution rules specified to prevent silent balance rewriting, data resurrection, or last-write-wins on financial transactions? [Completeness, Spec §RT-03, Constitution §II]
- [ ] CHK038 - Does the spec guarantee that exceeding Free tier limits or changing subscription state never deletes or excludes valid historical financial transactions? [Consistency, Spec §RN-CTA-03, Constitution §V]

## Notes
